verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֛י וָאֵ֖רֶא וְהִנֵּה־ אִ֑ישׁ וּבְיָד֖וֹ חֶ֥בֶל מִדָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eś·śā ‘ê·nay wā·’ê·re wə·hin·nêh- ’îš ū·ḇə·yā·ḏōw ḥe·ḇel mid·dāh
verses.literal: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw . . . a man with a measuring line in his hand
verses.literalPt: TORNEI a levantar os meus olhos, e vi, e eis um homem que tinha na mão um cordel de medir.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר אָ֖נָה אַתָּ֣ה הֹלֵ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י לָמֹד֙ אֶת־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִרְא֥וֹת כַּמָּֽה־ רָחְבָּ֖הּ וְכַמָּ֥ה אָרְכָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ā·nāh ’at·tāh hō·lêḵ way·yō·mer ’ê·lay lā·mōḏ ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim lir·’ō·wṯ kam·māh- rā·ḥə·bāh wə·ḵam·māh ’ā·rə·kāh
verses.literal: Where are you going I asked To measure Jerusalem he replied . . . and to determine . . . its width . . . and length
verses.literalPt: E eu disse: Para onde vais tu? E ele me disse: Vou medir Jerusalém, para ver qual é a sua largura e qual o seu comprimento.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י יֹצֵ֑א וּמַלְאָ֣ךְ אַחֵ֔ר יֹצֵ֖א לִקְרָאתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ham·mal·’āḵ had·dō·ḇêr bî yō·ṣê ū·mal·’āḵ ’a·ḥêr yō·ṣê liq·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then the angel who was speaking with me went forth and another angel came forward to meet him
verses.literalPt: E eis que saiu o anjo que falava comigo, e outro anjo lhe saiu ao encontro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔ו רֻ֗ץ דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ הַנַּ֥עַר הַלָּ֖ז לֵאמֹ֑ר פְּרָזוֹת֙ תֵּשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מֵרֹ֥ב אָדָ֛ם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ʾē·lå̄w ruṣ dab·bêr ’el- han·na·‘ar hal·lāz lê·mōr pə·rā·zō·wṯ tê·šêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim mê·rōḇ ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: and said to him Run and tell . . . that . . . young man Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the multitude of men and livestock within it
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe: Corre, fala a este jovem, dizendo: Jerusalém será habitada como as aldeias sem muros, por causa da multidão dos homens e dos animais que haverá nela.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י אֶֽהְיֶה־ לָּהּ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה ח֥וֹמַת אֵ֖שׁ סָבִ֑יב וּלְכָב֖וֹד אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’eh·yeh- lāh nə·’um- Yah·weh ḥō·w·maṯ ’êš sā·ḇîḇ ū·lə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ’eh·yeh ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: For I will be a wall of fire around it declares the LORD and I will be the glory within it
verses.literalPt: Pois eu, diz o SENHOR, serei para ela um muro de fogo em redor, e para glória estarei no meio dela.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי ה֗וֹי וְנֻ֛סוּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ צָפ֖וֹן נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֠י כְּאַרְבַּ֞ע רוּח֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם פֵּרַ֥שְׂתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w hō·w wə·nu·sū mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn nə·’um- Yah·weh kî kə·’ar·ba‘ rū·ḥō·wṯ haš·šā·ma·yim pê·raś·tî ’eṯ·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Get up Get up Flee from the land of the north declares the LORD for I have scattered you like the four winds of heaven declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ah, ah! Fugi agora da terra do norte, diz o SENHOR, porque vos espalhei pelos quatro ventos do céu, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: ה֥וֹי צִיּ֖וֹן הִמָּלְטִ֑י יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־ בָּבֶֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w ṣî·yō·wn him·mā·lə·ṭî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ baṯ- bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Get up O Zion Escape you who dwell with the Daughter of Babylon
verses.literalPt: Ah! Sião! Escapa, tu, que habitas com a filha de Babilônia.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ אַחַ֣ר כָּב֔וֹד שְׁלָחַ֕נִי אֶל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם הַשֹּׁלְלִ֣ים אֶתְכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י הַנֹּגֵ֣עַ בָּכֶ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ בְּבָבַ֥ת עֵינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’a·ḥar kā·ḇō·wḏ šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’el- hag·gō·w·yim haš·šō·lə·lîm ’eṯ·ḵem kî han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·ḵem nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·ḇā·ḇaṯ ‘ê·nōw
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts . . . says After His Glory has sent Me against the nations that have plundered you for whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Depois da glória ele me enviou às nações que vos despojaram; porque aquele que tocar em vós toca na menina do seu olho.

verses.original: כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֨י מֵנִ֤יף אֶת־ יָדִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל לְעַבְדֵיהֶ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחָֽנִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nî mê·nîp̄ ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘ă·lê·hem wə·hā·yū šā·lāl lə·‘aḇ·ḏê·hem wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·lā·ḥā·nî
verses.literal: I will surely wave My hand over them so that they will become plunder for their own servants Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me
verses.literalPt: Porque eis aí levantarei a minha mão sobre eles, e eles virão a ser a presa daqueles que os serviram; assim sabereis vós que o SENHOR dos Exércitos me enviou.

verses.original: רָנִּ֥י וְשִׂמְחִ֖י בַּת־ צִיּ֑וֹן כִּ֧י הִנְנִי־ בָ֛א וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכֵ֖ךְ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rān·nî wə·śim·ḥî baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn kî hin·nî- ḇā wə·šā·ḵan·tî ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Shout for joy and be glad O Daughter of Zion for . . . I am coming to dwell among you declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Exulta, e alegra-te ó filha de Sião, porque eis que venho, e habitarei no meio de ti, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְנִלְווּ֩ גוֹיִ֨ם רַבִּ֤ים אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֣י בְתוֹכֵ֔ךְ וְיָדַ֕עַתְּ כִּי־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֵלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nil·wū ḡō·w·yim rab·bîm ’el- Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·hā·yū lî lə·‘ām wə·šā·ḵan·tî ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ wə·yā·ḏa·‘at kî- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ê·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: On that day many nations will join themselves to the LORD and they will become My people I will dwell among you and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you
verses.literalPt: E naquele dia muitas nações se ajuntarão ao SENHOR, e serão o meu povo, e habitarei no meio de ti e saberás que o SENHOR dos Exércitos me enviou a ti.

verses.original: וְנָחַ֨ל יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ יְהוּדָה֙ חֶלְק֔וֹ עַ֖ל אַדְמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ḥal Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh ḥel·qōw ‘al ’aḏ·maṯ haq·qō·ḏeš ū·ḇā·ḥar ‘ō·wḏ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And the LORD will take possession of Judah as His portion in the Holy Land and He will once again choose Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR herdará a Judá como sua porção na terra santa, e ainda escolherá a Jerusalém.

verses.original: הַ֥ס כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֖ר מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י נֵע֖וֹר מִמְּע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: has kāl- bā·śār mip·pə·nê Yah·weh kî nê·‘ō·wr mim·mə·‘ō·wn qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: Be silent before the LORD all people for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling
verses.literalPt: Cala-te, toda a carne, diante do SENHOR, porque ele se levantou da sua santa morada.
